Context: 18. Night Duty

- (vii) The amount of NDA will be worked out separately for each employee depending upon the basic pay the concerned employee  
is drawing on the date of performing the night duty. The existing practice for giving same rate of NOA to all employees with a particular Grade Pay has been discontinued.  
(viii) A certificate should be given by the supervisor concerned that Night Duty is essential. - OM, dated 13-7-2020.
